inputs: The four bootstrap YAML contracts under company/
Task metadata from one invoking session: paths, capabilities, required outputs
invariants: Production never imports company/, ai_platform/ or knowledge/; Company OS is removable without breaking simulation, render or tests.
No component spawns subagents; extra perspectives are separate sequential sessions (constitution rule 2).
Company OS stays unconnected to production execution until the integration gate in docs/company_os_v1_bootstrap.md passes.
Deterministic code first, retrieval second, reasoning only where judgment adds value (constitution rule 4).
outputs: Validated config, routing results, handoff artifacts
Context manifests, knowledge records and capsule selections
purpose: The corporate control plane: bootstrap contracts, validation, capability routing, AI-efficiency primitives, the knowledge store and the capsule layer. It may inspect, plan and route work to production; production may never import it.
risks: The integration gate has not passed; treating any of this as production-wired is premature.
company/runtime and company/validation import each other, so the control plane has one real cycle inside it.
title: Company OS control plane
